notes:
A350:
• New: Passengers page on the crew panel: watch passengers board seat by seat, synced with GSX.
• New: Your airline's loyalty club: passengers are remembered between flights and earn miles and Silver, Gold or Platinum status.
• New: Tap a seat to see its passenger: name, status, miles and what they ordered.
• New: Orders arrive by seat with the passenger's name, with Accept and Served buttons.
• New: Seat screens show when a meal is being prepared and when it has been served.
A350 and 777:
• Fixed: Films stop at once when you press Stop.
• Fixed: YouTube finds Microsoft Edge on more PCs and says clearly when Edge didn't start.
App:
• Improved: Updates download only when you press Update, and the notes show once.
• Fixed: The Cabin app starts with the sim again on PCs where Windows blocked the change to exe.xml.
